messages:
maria: quick heads-up — publishing py + ts SDK today in the change window at 17:00 PT. doing an RC canary first, then flip. need pin strategy + rollback criteria. who can watch logs?

sam: ack, i'm on watch. i'll handle publish logs and smoke tests. fixed the signer mismatch earlier so should be smooth :thumbsup:

eli: quick Q — are we pinning the legacy sync client in npm deps or adding a deprecation shim? i'd prefer pin + clear warn in release notes.

dawn: +1 pin in package.json and deprecation warning in the notes. also use dist-tag 'next' not 'latest' until post-qa.

maria: plan: 
1) publish py wheel to 'next' with twine, tag v1.8.0-rc.2
2) publish npm package with dist-tag 'next' and pin legacy sync dependency to <1.8.0
3) run e2e smoke + integration tests (~30m)
4) if smoke ok, flip dist-tag to 'latest' and publish final release notes
5) if regression, rollback: yank rc, re-tag previous stable, notify affected customers

sam: copying commands here:
```
# python wheel
python -m build && twine upload --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/* --comment 'rc'
# npm
npm publish --tag next
```

deploy-bot: publish job queued: job_id=pub-9182, started by maria, targets=[python,npm], expected duration ~8m

deploy-bot: stdout: building wheel...
deploy-bot: stdout: npm pack -> ok

eli: running QA script now, posting failures if any.

dawn: reminder — bump CHANGELOG and add 'Deprecation: legacy sync client will be removed in next major' in release notes. include migration snippet.

sam: smoke tests green on auth + simple gen. latency within baseline.

deploy-bot: publish job completed: success. python: v1.8.0-rc.2 pushed to 'next', npm: v1.8.0-rc.2 tagged 'next'

maria: proceeding to flip dist-tag to 'latest' in 10m if no objections. publishing release notes now.

ben: hold on flip for 10m — Ops requests a 30m canary period for Dedicated customers. recommend 30m hold.

maria: OK extending to 30m. flipping at 17:30 PT unless regressions. thanks.

sam: rollback runbook notes:
- npm: npm dist-tag add <previous-stable-version> latest; npm dist-tag rm <rc-version> latest
- python: prefer to yank rc and re-upload previous stable wheel with micro bump if needed; otherwise notify customers and provide pinned install instruction

eli: found a minor test flake in the embeddings endpoint under high concurrency. logging details, not blocking yet but keep an eye.

dawn: i'll draft the deprecation note and migration code block and drop it in the release notes doc.

maria: thanks all — will update with final flip status. :wave:
